en: Black‑and‑white image showing a leafy outdoor scene with a small pavilion or kiosk on a low mound, surrounded by trees. The pavilion has a conical shingled roof and a fabric awning around its perimeter. In the background to the left is a half‑timbered building typical of Central European rural architecture, with outdoor tables set up as if for a garden restaurant or inn. Two people stand in front of the pavilion: a woman in a long dress and hat and a man in a suit, both in early 20th‑century clothing. A corner of the print is folded over at the lower left, reinforcing the postcard or photographic print appearance. No clear printed caption is visible.
